scenes.title: THE FARMER
scenes.say: A farmer has seventeen sheep. All but nine run away. How many sheep are left?
Nine! All but nine ran away, so nine are still there. If you said eight, you're not alone.
Tag a friend who would fall for this, and follow for more.
